name: ChatGPT Atlas
tagline: OpenAI's web browser with ChatGPT built in — sidebar, memories, and agent mode.
description: OpenAI's Chromium-based web browser with ChatGPT woven through it: a sidebar that can summarize, compare, and answer questions about any page, optional browser memories that carry context across sessions, and an agent mode that navigates sites and completes multi-step tasks on your behalf. It launched on macOS in October 2025, with Windows, iOS, and Android versions announced. Free with any ChatGPT account; agent mode requires a paid plan.
insight: OpenAI's first web browser; in March 2026 OpenAI said it will fold Atlas, the ChatGPT desktop app, and Codex into one application.

modelSupport.notes: Runs on OpenAI's ChatGPT models; capability follows your ChatGPT plan.

edge: No browser ties deeper into ChatGPT — your existing account brings memories, chat history, and agent mode to every page without a separate assistant.
cons: Agent mode needs a paid plan

references.title: OpenAI launches ChatGPT Atlas AI browser on macOS
